name: Bosnia and Herzegovina (1992–1998)
author: The authors of the final version of the officially adopted flag are Prof. Dr. Enver Imamović and graphic designer Zvonimir Bebek. Other authors from the Working Group prior to the dissolution can be found in the cited sources. The SVG version was created based on official documentation and other relevant sources, as cited above, by LeCorbusierB NRMostar (Reddit username u/LeCorbusierB) and FiliusBosnensis (Reddit username u/filius_bosnensis). It was entirely created from scratch, without using other people’s work. The original author of the previous, i.e. the older version of the flag that had been in use before the change, is Kseferovic. Others later revised his coat of arms on several occasions. See the file history for more information.
